H5300.def: for «05304»; Nephushesim, a Temple- servant:--Nephisesim (from the margin).

H5301.def: a primitive root; to puff, in various applications (literally, to inflate, blow hard, scatter, kindle, expire; figuratively, to disesteem):--blow, breath, give up, cause to lose (life), seething, snuff.

H5302.def: from «05301»; a gust; Nophach, a place in Moab:--Nophah.

H5303.def: or nphil {nef-eel'}; from «05307»; properly, a feller, i.e. a bully or tyrant:--giant.

H5304.et: from an unused root meaning to scatter
H5304.def: plural from an unused root meaning to scatter; expansions; Nephisim, a Temple-servant:--Nephusim (from the margin).

H5305.def: from «05314»; refreshed; Naphish, a son of Ishmael, and his posterity:--Naphish.

H5306.et: from an unused root meaning to glisten
H5306.def: from an unused root meaning to glisten; shining; a gem, probably the garnet:--emerald.

H5307.def: a primitive root; to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative):--be accepted, cast (down, self, (lots), out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell(-ing), fugitive, have (inheritance), inferior, be judged (by mistake for «06419»), lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be (X hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present(-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, × surely, throw down.

H5309.def: or nephel {nay'-fel}; from «05307»; something fallen, i.e. an abortion:--untimely birth.

H5310.def: a primitive root; to dash to pieces, or scatter:--be beaten in sunder, break (in pieces), broken, dash (in pieces), cause to be discharged, dispersed, be overspread, scatter.

H5312.def: (Aramaic) a primitive root; to issue; causatively, to bring out:--come (go, take) forth (out).

H5314.def: a primitive root; to breathe; passively, to be breathed upon, i.e. (figuratively) refreshed (as if by a current of air):--(be) refresh selves (-ed).

H5315.def: from «05314»; properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental):--any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, × dead(-ly), desire, × (dis-)contented, × fish, ghost, + greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, × jeopardy of) life (X in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-)self, them (your)-selves, + slay, soul, + tablet, they, thing, (X she) will, × would have it.

H5317.et: from (05130) in the sense of shaking to pieces
H5317.def: from «05130» in the sense of shaking to pieces; a dripping i.e. of honey (from the comb):--honeycomb.

H5318.def: from «06605»; opened, i.e. a spring; Nephtoach, a place in Palestine:--Neptoah.

H5319.def: from «06617»; properly, wrestled; but ued (in the plural) transitively, a struggle:--wrestling.

H5320.et: of foreign origin, Naphtuhim, an Egyptian tribe
H5320.def: plural of foreign origin, Naphtuchim, an Egyptian tribe:--Naptuhim.

H5321.def: from «06617»; my wrestling; Naphtali, a son of Jacob, with the tribe descended from him, and its territory:--Naphtali.

H5322.def: from «05340»; a flower (from its brilliancy); also a hawk (from it flashing speed); --blossom, hawk.

H5323.def: a primitive root; to go away; --flee.

H5324.def: a prim root; to station, in various applications (literally or figuratively):--appointed, deputy, erect, establish, × Huzzah (by mistake for a proper name), lay, officer, pillar, present, rear up, set (over, up), settle, sharpen, establish, (make to) stand(-ing, still, up, upright), best state.

H5325.def: passive participle of «05324»; fixed, i.e. a handle:--haft.

H5326.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «05324»; fixedness, i.e. firmness:--strength.

H5327.def: a primitive root; properly, to go forth, i.e. (by implication) to be expelled, and (consequently) desolate; causatively, to lay waste; also (specifically), to quarrel:--be laid waste, runinous, strive (together).

H5329.def: a primitive root; properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); also (as denominative from «05331»), to be permanent:--excel, chief musician (singer), oversee(-r), set forward.

H5330.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05329»; to become chief:--be preferred.

H5331.def: or netsach {nay'-tsakh}; from «05329»; properly, a goal, i.e. the bright object at a distance travelled towards; hence (figuratively), splendor, or (subjectively) truthfulness, or (objectively) confidence; but usually (adverbially), continually (i.e. to the most distant point of view); --alway(-s), constantly, end, (+ n-)ever(more), perpetual, strength, victory.

H5332.et: probably identical with (05331), through the idea of brilliancy of colour
H5332.def: probably identical with «05331», through the idea of brilliancy of color; juice of the grape (as blood red):--blood, strength.

H5333.def: or ntsib {nets-eeb'}; from «05324»; something stationary, i.e. a prefect, a military post, a statue:--garrison, officer, pillar.

H5334.def: the same as «05333»; station; Netsib, a place in Palestine:--Nezib.

H5335.def: from «05329»; conspicuous; Netsiach, a Temple- servant:--Neziah.

H5336.def: from «05341»; properly, conservative; but used passively, delivered:--preserved.

H5337.def: a primitive root; to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense:- × at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, × without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recover, rescue, rid, save, spoil, strip, × surely, take (out).

H5340.def: a primitive root; to glare, i.e. be bright- colored:--sparkle.

H5341.def: a primitive root; to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.):-- besieged, hidden thing, keep(-er, -ing), monument, observe, preserve(-r), subtil, watcher(-man).

H5342.et: from (05341) in the sense of greenness as a striking colour
H5342.def: from «05341» in the sense of greenness as a striking color; a shoot; figuratively, a descendant:--branch.

H5343.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «05352»; clean:--pure.

H5344.def: a primitive root; to puncture, literally (to perforate, with more or less violence) or figuratively (to specify, designate, libel):--appoint, blaspheme, bore, curse, express, with holes, name, pierce, strike through.

H5346.def: the same as «05345»; dell; Nekeb, a place in Palestine:--Nekeb.

H5348.et: from an unused root meaning to mark (by puncturing or branding)
H5348.def: from an unused root meaning to mark (by puncturing or branding); spotted:--speckled.

H5349.et: active participle from the same as (05348)
H5349.def: active participle from the same as «05348»; a spotter (of sheep or cattle), i.e. the owner or tender (who thus marks them):-- herdman, sheepmaster.

H5350.def: from the same as «05348»; a crumb (as broken to spots); also a biscuit (as pricked):--cracknel, mouldy.

H5352.def: a primitive root; to be (or make) clean (literally or figuratively); by implication (in an adverse sense) to be bare, i.e. extirpated:--acquit × at all, × altogether, be blameless, cleanse, (be) clear(-ing), cut off, be desolate, be free, be (hold) guiltless, be (hold) innocent, × by no means, be quit, be (leave) unpunished, × utterly, × wholly.

H5353.et: from (05348) (in the fig. sense of marked)
H5353.def: feminine of «05348» (in the figurative sense of marked); distinction; Nekoda, a Temple-servant:--Nekoda.

H5355.def: or naqiyi (Joel «04» : «019»; Jonah «01» : «014»), {naw-kee'}; from «05352»; innocent:--blameless, clean, clear, exempted, free, guiltless, innocent, quit.

H5356.def: or niqqayon {nik-kaw-yone'}; from «05352»; clearness (literally or figuratively):--cleanness, innocency.

H5357.et: from an unused root meaning to bore
H5357.def: from an unused root meaning to bore; a cleft:--hole.

H5358.def: a primitive root; to grudge, i.e. avenge or punish:--avenge(-r, self), punish, revenge (self), × surely, take vengeance.

H5360.def: feminine of «05359»; avengement, whether the act of the passion:--+ avenge, revenge(-ing), vengeance.

H5361.def: a primitive root; to feel aversion:--be alienated.

H5362.def: a primitive root; to strike with more or less violence (beat, fell, corrode); by implication (of attack) to knock together, i.e. surround or circulate:--compass (about, -ing), cut down, destroy, go round (about), inclose, round.

H5365.def: a primitive root; to bore (penetrate, quarry):--dig, pick out, pierce, put (thrust) out.

H5367.def: a primitive root; to entrap (with a noose), literally or figuratively:--catch (lay a) snare.

H5368.et: corresponding to (05367); but used in the sense of (05362)
H5368.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05367»; but used in the sense of «05362»; to knock:--smote.

H5369.def: the same as «05216»; lamp; Ner, an Israelite:--Ner.

H5370.def: of foreign origin; Nergal, a Cuthite deity:--Nergal.

H5371.def: from «05370» and «08272»; Nergal-Sharetser, the name of two Babylonians:--Nergal-sharezer.

H5372.et: from an unused root meaning to roll to pieces
H5372.def: from an unused root meaning to roll to pieces; a slanderer:--talebearer, whisperer.

H5373.def: of foreign origin; nard, an aromatic:--spikenard.

H5374.def: or Neriyahuw {nay-ree-yaw'-hoo}; from «05216» and «03050»; light of Jah; Nerijah, an Israelite:--Neriah.

H5375.def: or nacah (Psalm «04» : «06» («07»)) {naw-saw'}; a primitive root; to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absol. and rel. (as follows):--accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable (+ man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, × needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, + swear, take (away, up), × utterly, wear, yield.

H5376.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05375»:--carry away, make insurrection, take.

H5377.def: a primitive root; to lead astray, i.e. (mentally) to delude, or (morally) to seduce:--beguile, deceive, × greatly, × utterly.

H5378.et: a primitive root [perhaps identical with (05377), through the idea of imposition]
H5378.def: a primitive root (perhaps identical with «05377», through the idea of imposition); to lend on interest; by implication, to dun for debt:--X debt, exact, giver of usury.

H5379.def: passive participle feminine of «05375»; something taken, i.e. a present:--gift.

H5380.def: a primitive root; to blow; by implication, to disperse:--(cause to) blow, drive away.

H5381.def: a primitive root; to reach (literally or figuratively):--ability, be able, attain (unto), (be able to, can) get, lay at, put, reach, remove, wax rich, × surely, (over-)take (hold of, on, upon).

H5382.def: a primitive root; to forget; figuratively, to neglect; causatively, to remit, remove:--forget, deprive, exact.

H5383.et: a primitive root [rather identical with (05382), in the sense of (05378)]
H5383.def: a primitive root (rather identical with «05382», in the sense of «05378»); to lend or (by reciprocity) borrow on security or interest:--creditor, exact, extortioner, lend, usurer, lend on (taker on) usury.

H5384.et: from (05382), in the sense of failure
H5384.def: from «05382», in the sense of failure; rheumatic or crippled (from the incident to Jacob):--which shrank.

H5385.def: or rather, nsutah {nes-oo-aw'}; feminine. passive participle of «05375»; something borne, i.e. a load:--carriage.

H5387.def: or «0nasi8» {naw-see'}; from «05375»; properly, an exalted one, i.e. a king or sheik; also a rising mist:--captain, chief, cloud, governor, prince, ruler, vapour.

H5391.def: a primitive root; to strike with a sting (as a serpent); figuratively, to oppress with interest on a loan:--bite, lend upon usury.

H5394.def: a primitive root; to pluck off, i.e. divest, eject or drop:--cast (out), drive, loose, put off (out), slip.

H5395.def: a primitive root; properly, to blow away, i.e. destroy:--destroy.

H5397.def: from «05395»; a puff, i.e. wind, angry or vital breath, divine inspiration, intellect. or (concretely) an animal:--blast, (that) breath(-eth), inspiration, soul, spirit.

H5398.def: a primitive root; to breeze, i.e. blow up fresh (as the wind):--blow.

H5399.def: from «05398»; properly, a breeze, i.e. (by implication) dusk (when the evening breeze prevails):--dark, dawning of the day (morning), night, twilight.
